# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

Participation in this project is meant to be a harassment-free experience for
everyone.

## Our standards

Behaviour that keeps it that way.

- Welcoming and inclusive language
- Respect for differing viewpoints and experience
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
- Focusing on what is best for the project and the people using it

Behaviour that does not.

- Harassment, insults and personal attacks
- Public or private abuse
- Publishing private information without explicit permission
- Anything that would be inappropriate in a professional setting

## Enforcement

The maintainer may remove, edit or reject comments, commits, code, issues and
other contributions that do not align with this Code of Conduct. Report conduct
problems privately through GitHub rather than in a public thread.
